_root.note: Invisible to the node census: the discovery rule skips dunders as plumbing, so the single place where the nervous system's state is created is outside the map. Per the operator's map (model error 4), an assignment proves the initialization site, not ownership.

state_initialization._discovery_rule: Fields = `self.X = ...` and `self.X: T = ...` inside AgentLoopInit.__init__. Use = `self.X` anywhere in core/loop*.py, PLUS getattr/setattr/hasattr(self, 'X') with a literal name. Outside use = the same attribute name reached on any object anywhere in the repo — a candidate, not proof, since another class may carry the same name.
_rule_blind_to: attribute names built at runtime (getattr(self, prefix + name))
access through a collaborator holding a reference to the loop
state_initialization._rule_history: Two false results were produced and corrected before this snapshot was written. The first pass counted `self.X` in every class, so fields named llm/log/policy/registry looked per-run because OTHER classes assign their own. The second missed getattr access and declared `durable_writes` and `experience_retrieval` dead — both are live, read at core/loop_memory_write.py:114 and core/loop_memory_read.py:200 through getattr with a literal name.

per_run.meaning: written somewhere in the perimeter during a run, so the value does not survive as constructed

read_only_in_perimeter.meaning: organs and configuration: the loop reads them, never reassigns

outside_only.meaning: mirror of replan_policy.max_total_replans; nothing in the perimeter reads it

dead.meaning: assigned at construction, never read or written by anyone, getattr included

by_origin.note: Origin classifies where the VALUE came from, not who owns it. `injected` means the constructor received it — the strongest argument that the loop is NOT its owner.

state_initialization.owner_note: Protocol item 6: initialization site, lifetime and type are provable; ownership is a separate claim and is not derived from `self.X = ...`.

path_ledger._mandate: Operator mandate 2026-08-08: dissect, prove and certify the whole CNS runtime control path. Clusters follow the REAL execution graph from runtime entry points, never file order. Statuses from path_statuses; UNPROVEN never becomes an assumption; a call edge is never a proven signal flow. A cluster is closed only when its report (SCOPE -> EXECUTION PATH -> SIGNALS/STATE -> OWNERSHIP -> FAILURE SEMANTICS -> TEST EVIDENCE -> MUTATION EVIDENCE -> VERDICT -> NEXT EDGE) exists and its critical contracts have proven bites. This ledger is the work queue and the proof journal, not the goal.
